value.rationale: The actual binary-schedule search contains \(2^L\) patterns. The one-switch proof reduces exact global minimization to a monotone threshold, with explicit tie boundaries and a structurally different overhead response for pointlike versus positive-dimensional refinement. Both AMR cost analysis and Nyx implementation literature motivate optimizing partial subcycling rather than just comparing full with no subcycling. The result has an exact self-contained scope despite idealized costs; no empirical performance claim is needed.
